Goodwyn — a tea cart, designed.

A retail/product-design commission for the tea brand Goodwyn: a compact, inexpensive, easy-to-keep cart to brew and sell tea in airport terminals and hotel lobbies. From brief and reference, through ideation sketches, to two resolved concepts and a final 3D render — teal and brass, a marble top, a "tea over coffee?" panel.

Retail / product design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·45.
